context_and_flow.screen_type: Mobile application authentication and login screen.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To allow existing users to log into their Mimo account via email or social providers.
ux_patterns: The illustration features a character/mascot which serves both as a friendly visual cue and thematic reinforcement of 'welcoming back'.
The layout follows standard mobile login patterns with a primary CTA and secondary social login row.
The design uses a monochromatic purple theme for UI elements, maintaining brand consistency.
The mascot is positioned centrally to draw focus while reinforcing the warm, welcoming tone.
